subject: Request: temporary quota uplift + staged billing for July launch
messages:
From: Priya Nair <priya@launchly.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Launchly Billing <billing@launchly.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Jul 30 launch — temporary uplift request and billing options

Hi Olga,

We're ramping to GA for our personalization feature on Jul 30 and are expecting a short window spike (estimated +220% token volume) for ~10 days. Our procurement lead asked whether Redwood can do a temporary quota elevation (short term) and how that would be billed — prorated overage vs. a short-term committed uplift.

I've attached our recent usage exports and a projected traffic curve. Can your team advise the cleanest path to avoid throttles while keeping our finance team happy?

Attachments: usage_report_q3.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Priya Nair
Head of Product Operations
Launchly, Inc.
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Priya Nair <priya@launchly.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Jul 30 launch — temporary uplift request and billing options

Hi Priya — thanks for the data, that helps. Quick summary of options so we can move fast: 

1) Short-term uplift (preferred for launch): we can provision a temporary quota increase for a 14-day window. Billing options: a) prorated pay-as-you-go at your current rate (no discount) or b) a temporary uplift at a blended committed rate (we'd apply a one-time uplift discount).

2) Split-billing / department pass-through: if you want to isolate the surge to a dedicated billing code, we can create a staged invoice and map usage to a separate charge to make PO reconciliation easier.

3) Fallback policy: automated throttling to a fallback model if we hit safety limits — we can avoid hard 429s by enabling canary routing to smaller models.

I looped in Ben for pricing flexibility and Laura for procurement/legal signoff. If you can confirm the exact uplift window (dates) and whether Launchly prefers a single blended uplift charge or invoiced split, we'll draft an amendment. 

Provisional ask: do you want the uplift to start Jul 29 (pre-warm) and run through Aug 8?

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, Priya Nair <priya@launchly.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Jul 30 launch — temporary uplift request and billing options

Priya / Olga — happy to make this straightforward. Suggestion: offer a 12% uplift discount if Launchly commits to a short-term uplift window (14 days) and a PO is issued before Jul 28. That softens the cost delta vs. pure paygo. If Launchly prefers split invoicing, we can set up a separate charge code and finalize with finance.

Two small caveats: 1) discount applies only to token usage attributed to the uplift window; 2) we require a purchase order or signed amendment before we apply the blended rate.

I can draft the amendment and send as a DocuSign envelope once Laura confirms the language from legal/procurement.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Priya Nair <priya@launchly.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Jul 30 launch — temporary uplift request and billing options

Looping in procurement guidelines: we can accept a PO for the uplift but need the following to speed legal review: 
- Exact uplift start/end dates and expected maximum QPS/token delta
- Which account/billing code to map the uplift to (if split invoicing desired)
- Whether Launchly requires any additional data residency or audit clauses for the uplift period

I'll prepare a short amendment (1 page) that includes the staged billing table and a 14-day blackout clause for refunds. Once Priya confirms the three items above, Ben can send the DocuSign.

Attachments: proposed_amendment_OLGA_v1.pdf (pdf)

—Laura Bennett
Sr. Manager, Contracts & Procurement — Redwood Inference
From: Priya Nair <priya@launchly.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, Launchly Billing <billing@launchly.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Jul 30 launch — temporary uplift request and billing options

Thanks, team — we confirm the uplift window Jul 29 — Aug 8 and prefer the blended uplift (single invoice) to keep our finance team simple. Estimated extra tokens: ~2.1M tokens over the window; QPS peak ~3.5x baseline. No additional residency clauses.

Please proceed with the 14-day amendment and send DocuSign. We'll get PO over if needed but would prefer the DocuSign route for speed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Priya
Head of Product Operations — Launchly, Inc.
